case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
sup:70610.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
sup:70610.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Your offer speaks of reliable delivery and a long relationship, and that is the spirit in which we write. Our options give your plant what a family firm values most: a binding volume over a long contract term, on top of what you supply us today.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives you the steadiest load for your plant while our orders with you have always run at stable prices.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our past orders of the bolt:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

On the matching nut:
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.17; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As this is a decision beyond your own desk, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who decides at Leitner & Sohn. For them it means a binding volume over the full contract term, business added to your current supply and a clear plan for your capacity, for a fair solution between two family-run companies.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your proposal and the historical data; while we acknowledge the stable order history, please note that some of the cited records do not directly apply to this specific bundle. We are fully authorized to handle this negotiation and are prepared to extend the contract term to 36 months and adjust the payment terms to 45 days to support your long-term planning. In response to your commitment to a binding volume, we can offer a revised price of €5.58 per unit for this package. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

Our offer is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €5.58 per unit. An alternative package provides a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
